title: Robot dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='30' y='10' width='40' height='30' rx='8' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- face screen -->
  <rect x='35' y='15' width='30' height='20' rx='5' fill='#1A2A3A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='23' r='3.5' fill='#00FFAA'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='23' r='3.5' fill='#00FFAA'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M42 29 Q50 34 58 29' stroke='#00FFAA' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='3' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='2' r='3' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='33' y='42' width='34' height='28' rx='6' fill='#5BA0E8'/>
  <!-- chest light -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- left arm raised up dancing -->
  <line x1='33' y1='48' x2='18' y2='30' stroke='#5BA0E8' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='27' r='5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- right arm out to side dancing -->
  <line x1='67' y1='48' x2='84' y2='42' stroke='#5BA0E8' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='41' r='5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- left leg kicked out -->
  <line x1='42' y1='70' x2='28' y2='90' stroke='#4A90D9' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- right leg bent dancing -->
  <line x1='58' y1='70' x2='68' y2='85' stroke='#4A90D9' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='85' x2='62' y2='93' stroke='#4A90D9' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='94' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#FF6B6B'>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='20' rx='4' ry='3'/>
    <line x1='82' y1='20' x2='82' y2='10' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='2'/>
    <path d='M82 10 Q86 12 84 16' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#00FFAA'>
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='15' rx='3' ry='2.5'/>
    <line x1='23' y1='15' x2='23' y2='7' stroke='#00FFAA' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
